Meanwhile, Commodity Trading Advisors are also signaling a cautious shift in market positioning, with CTAs positioned as sellers of U.S. equities across most forward-looking scenarios. This shift accompanies a broader trend of selling in European equities, which led global CTA selling over the past week with $18B in offloaded positions.
Looking ahead, quantitative models suggest that in a bearish tape, CTAs could sell up to $105B in global equities, highlighting the potential for further market volatility, the note said.
